synthetic_validation.note: Routed 2D surface pass vs the INDEPENDENT local (non-routed) reference on the same controlled forcing. This validates pipeline behaviour on synthetic data only; it says NOTHING about real-world accuracy and is completely separate from real-event validation.

generation_method: seeded synthetic forcing through the canonical runtime pipeline (rainfall->inflow->chain->2D surface pass->depth->road depth)
claim_policy: SIMULATED / SYNTHETIC SCENARIO: demonstrates system behaviour under controlled reproducible forcing. NOT real observations, NOT real-event accuracy, NOT a prediction for any city.
